laws.rule: Schaffhausen's rest-day and shop-closing Act (Ruhetagsgesetz, arts 1 to 3, 7 and 8): public rest days are Sundays and the holidays New Year's Day, Good Friday, Easter Monday, 1 May, Ascension, Whit Monday, 1 August, Christmas Day and St Stephen's Day. High holidays are Good Friday, Easter Sunday, Whit Sunday, the Federal Day of Prayer and Christmas Day. On public rest days, work, activities or events that seriously disturb the quiet and dignity of the day by noise or otherwise are banned. On high holidays, shooting practice and sports events of any kind, non-religious public events and processions, and variety shows are also banned. Shops may open on weekdays from 05:00 to 22:00 in summer and from 06:00 to 22:00 in winter, but must close at 18:00 on the evening before a public rest day. Shops stay closed on public rest days, except businesses for which federal law allows Sunday work.
